candidates.name: BindingSlots
candidates.state: M fixed slots; deployed state M*d (32*128=4096/layer); [B,N,M,D] is a training-time cumsum scan artifact, not persistent
candidates.write_rule: addr=softmax(W_wk x . SlotKeys^T); w=sigmoid(gate) * addr; slot=cumsum(w v)/cumsum(w)
candidates.read_rule: raddr=softmax(W_rq x . SlotKeys^T); out=W_o(sum_m raddr_m slot_m)

candidates.name: BoundedBindingSlots
candidates.state: M fixed slots; keys/values/source/version/usage/active; O(M*D), streaming read-then-write
candidates.write_rule: cosine-address to active slots; match>=thr -> supersede same slot + version++; else free slot else LRU evict; convex-combine by gate
candidates.read_rule: top-k soft attention over active slots (dot / sqrt(Ds))
candidates.overwrite: supersede-in-place with version bump; hard LRU eviction on allocation
candidates.note: validation ladder explicitly DEFERRED in source docstring ('No binding capability claimed as demonstrated')

selection.rationale: It is the implementation that produced the ONLY measured positive slot result (abc.json), carries the built-in causal ablation hooks the harness used (zero / rand_keys), has a reproducible matched harness, is Phase-independent as a module, is bounded, and builds no N x N tensor. Selection criteria 1 (positive measured result), 2 (causal slots-off evidence) and 7 (reproducible harness) are decisive for a REPRODUCTION phase.
selection.extension_rationale: It is the only implementation with clean source / version / supersession / eviction semantics (criterion 6) and is the target for the NOT-YET-DEMONSTRATED relational capabilities. Its validation was deferred, so it is incubated as the metadata-extended variant, not as the reproduction target.
selection.stdlib_rationale: A dependency-free reference implementing the union of testable DISCRETE mechanics (content addressing, supersession+version, source retention, LRU eviction, bounded state, no N x N) so behavioural/complexity claims run WITHOUT torch. It is also the parity oracle the torch modules must match once torch is available.
selection.not_selected_by: class name, file date, or documentation language alone
